local_review.finding_body: Review Signal #6 was violated at `stats/io.github.microcks/microcks-testcontainers/0.5.0/stats.json`: the submitted evidence reported 0/4 dynamic-access calls (0%), but a new-library contribution with calls to cover must exceed 20%. Review Signal #1's single-library scope was also violated by the unrelated repository-wide change to `tests/tck-build-logic/src/main/java/org/graalvm/internal/tck/GrypeTask.java`; build logic is not a supporting file for this coordinate.
local_review.finding_title: New-library contribution misses the dynamic-access gate and includes build logic
local_review.fix_note: Changed `MicrocksContainerTest` to exercise the library's public classpath snapshot/artifact APIs, using a resource-only context class loader backed by copied fixture files so the same behavior passes under Native Image. Regenerated `stats.json`, which now reports 2/4 (50%) dynamic-access coverage, and restored `GrypeTask.java` to the base version so it is absent from the eventual PR diff.
local_review.review_comment: Checked the single-coordinate diff, test source and build configuration, metadata file names and scope, local gate evidence, and resolved statistics against all applicable library-new-request rules. The repaired test is library-specific, runs the same asserted behavior on JVM and Native Image, is version-agnostic, uses a separate test package, and now reports 2/4 (50%) dynamic-access coverage. The metadata-entry mismatch threshold is not triggered. `./gradlew test -Pcoordinates=io.github.microcks:microcks-testcontainers:0.5.0`, coordinate Checkstyle, stats generation, and stats validation passed on the repaired tree. The resulting eventual PR diff is scoped to the target coordinate plus its required allowed-Docker-image entry, so I approve it.
